alt_text: Two panels show the audited memory feature-intersection test. The conditional negative-side Hessian feature is positive at lower memory and negative at higher memory, with empirical feature-and-location envelopes; the central value is a small nominal residual. The second panel preserves the actual signed primary and cyclic trace residuals. All three targets are admitted, and no line connects the targets.

public_summary.scope: Conditional Hessian-feature estimates at numerically corrected intersections; the Hessian eigenvector need not be the geometric normal of its feature locus. Empirical envelopes are not confidence intervals or verified neural bounds. Actual trace residuals are retained as measured. No exact zero, ridge crossing, between-case connection, or superstability is established.
